expected.reason: Plan of Work M2 makes typeText positive: cua returns successfully, inserts the marker exactly once and leaves gedit alive. The pinned x64 vendor engine still answers `editable Paste did not insert text`, inserts nothing and leaves gedit alive, the declared vendor defect named above.

Plan of Work M2 makes paste positive: cua returns successfully, inserts the marker exactly once and leaves gedit alive. The pinned x64 vendor engine still answers `editable Paste did not insert text`, inserts nothing and leaves gedit alive, the declared vendor defect named above. The two leading errors are the case's intentional html and md format-refusal probes, which the facade rejects before either engine is called.

vendorDefects.reason: On the #171 x86-64 VM the pinned vendor engine (sky_linux_x64, under cua's own host, the only one Linux serves) answers typeText with `editable Paste did not insert text` after its 10 s EditableText.PasteText attempt; gedit (GTK 3) survives and the marker never reaches the text. Plan of Work M2's positive oracle requires success, exactly one marker and a surviving window, so this is recorded vendor behaviour, not passing coverage. This declaration names x64 only; arm64's distinct crash outcome will be measured and declared with M5's native-suite run.
